prompt: This template is built to be driven by coding agents — read AGENTS.md first. If .env is missing, run `pnpm bootstrap --yes` to provision. Each git branch gets its own local database, so re-run it on a new branch.

hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { [ ! -x /opt/node24/bin/node ] || { export PATH="/opt/node24/bin:$PATH"; [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || echo 'export PATH="/opt/node24/bin:$PATH"' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; }; } && pnpm install || true

[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && { id -u supabase-postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --user-group supabase-postgres; } && echo 'export SUPABASE_NATIVE_POSTGRES_USER=supabase-postgres' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" || true
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && pnpm exec ultracite fix --hook
